# Startup readback: AI-45

Contract version: 1

## Objective and acceptance outcomes

AI-45 makes evidence and backups recoverable across both PostgreSQL and private R2. The ticket is complete when: (1) the real backup/export records its database/migration checkpoint and linked archive objects with integrity metadata while retaining original file bytes; (2) that backup restores into a clean isolated recovery environment with relational links, trace/evidence retrieval, and SHA-256 file bytes verified; and (3) missing or corrupted objects fail with an actionable integrity result, recovery material stays encrypted/private, and the RPO/RTO and manual recovery path are documented. The required staging proof also repeats a representative read/report journey and records `LIVE E2E SIGN-OFF: PASS`.

## Dependencies and relevant contracts

AI-9 is Done; PR #140 merged as `651067cbf9ee1b6296580a38e2e37be65ddcd26f`, establishing release-gated migration and environment parity. AI-19 is Done; PR #171's accepted proof was based on head `01b61d1cf3a0b62ac45ec0608bbff2b3bcc23279` and merged as `daae0525b7a06d897e045390d8d91297d3324276`, establishing trace, audit, evidence, freshness, and archive metadata contracts. AI-65 is Done; its redacted manifest and live evidence verify separate private staging/production R2 bucket canaries, but do not verify application-level archive restore. The operator currently cannot identify or confirm the dedicated AI-45 recovery project, recovery bucket, or versioned backup key; do not provision replacements or invent credentials. Follow the Build Spec's PostgreSQL operational store/private R2 archive, original-byte preservation, SHA-256 metadata, encrypted backup, and restore-drill requirements; follow the Agent Spec's trace/evidence provenance and Systems recovery ownership. Apply the Frontend Constitution to the MFA-gated archived-evidence retrieval state. Extend existing `source_objects` producers (`finance-import` and `health-ingest`), the private Worker finance R2 gateway, and `trace_events.archive_reference`; `packages/integrations/src/r2.ts` currently provides only an in-memory test adapter. Integration risks: DB-02, DB-03, ACC-01, OPS-01.

## Implementation and boundaries

The finance gateway previously trusted PUT metadata and returned a database-usable key without a GET/read-back. The R2 write boundary now verifies exact bytes, size, MIME, and SHA-256, and its caller requires the explicit verified marker. An owner-scoped archive download path checks database ownership, consumes a one-time fresh-MFA `archive_read` gate, then verifies private R2 bytes against the stored SHA/size/MIME. The new backup utility captures database/migration metadata and exact referenced R2 bytes in a versioned AES-256-GCM encrypted bundle, with GET/decrypt read-back; production restore is refused and staging restore requires distinct recovery resources. Keep operational rows in PostgreSQL and raw files, large trace payloads, archives, and backups in private R2 with validated references. Recovery credentials and backup secrets must not enter browser code, ordinary logs, test fixtures, or evidence. Use synthetic staging data and an isolated recovery target; never overwrite production or copy production personal data. The confirmed gateway defect is recorded as R2-01 with its regression proof and failure-ledger entry.

## Local tests and commands

Use focused tests for the touched archive/backup boundary: valid encrypted round trip, wrong key/corrupt envelope, missing/extra/truncated/hash-mismatched object, archive PUT/read-back mismatch, owner scoping, MFA gate enforcement, and actionable redacted errors. The confirmed R2 defect was that the gateway accepted the PUT result and emitted a usable archive reference without a subsequent GET; missing or corrupted persisted bytes could pass. Regression command: `corepack pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run 'app/api/internal/finance-archive/route.test.ts' 'lib/archive-gateway.test.ts'`; the tests now require corrupted bytes to return `502 archive_readback_mismatch`, missing read-back to return `502 archive_readback_missing`, and success only after verified bytes and metadata. Current local results: 11 archive route/gateway tests pass; 5 backup integrity tests and restore-isolation guard test pass; web typecheck and strict backup CLI typecheck pass; both changed Deno functions pass `deno check --no-config`. Migration `20261021131411` applies locally and `corepack pnpm exec supabase test db --local supabase/tests/ai45_archive_restore.sql` passes all 18 assertions. The full `corepack pnpm verify:changed` gate passed after formatting and restore-isolation guard updates.

## Hosted proof and readiness

AI-65's bucket canaries are prerequisites only. The operator has not confirmed the dedicated staging recovery project, recovery bucket, or backup-key secret, so no live backup or restore has been run. Resume when the operator supplies these resources and scoped credentials; follow `docs/operations/backup-restore.md` to create/verify/restore synthetic staging data, compare critical counts and links, verify original bytes and archived trace access, then corrupt or remove only a disposable object in the isolated recovery bucket. Record the representative restored application journey and `LIVE E2E SIGN-OFF: PASS`. If the read journey prompts for login/MFA, stop before sign-in and tell the parent when the headed browser is ready. Production receives only the release pipeline's bounded affected-capability smoke; no destructive restore is permitted there.

## Delegation and blockers

One owner is accountable from implementation through merge; no subagent handoff is planned. AI-9, AI-19, and AI-65 are complete and their relevant contracts are available. The parent controls shared migration-prefix and integration-rule coordination and the staged QA schedule. If staging requires a headed login or MFA, stop before sign-in and tell the parent when the browser is ready for the user's action. Current known gates are the ticket-specific isolated restore proof, required CI, merge, and bounded production smoke.
